name: Peon Ping — AI Agent Sound Notifications
description: Installs peon-ping and the Peon Pet VS Code extension for game character voice notifications when your AI coding agent finishes or needs permission. Supports VS Code/Copilot, Cursor, and Codex with audio relay for devcontainers.

packs.description: Sound packs to install: 'default' (peon, peasant, sc_kerrigan, sc_battlecruiser, glados), 'all', or a comma-separated list (e.g. 'peon,glados,murloc')

packsLang.description: Restrict pack selection to language(s), e.g. 'fr' or 'en,fr' — passed straight through to the installer's own --lang flag, which understands per-pack language metadata (not just name matching, e.g. matches 'peon_fr'). Left empty, no language filtering happens. If set while 'packs' is still 'default', searches the full pack registry instead of just the 5 default franchise picks — those 5 may not all have a matching-language variant.

ideSetup.description: IDEs to configure: 'all' (vscode + cursor + codex), 'none', or a comma-separated list (e.g. 'vscode,cursor')
